name: Kocsér (Hungary)
description: Medium blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kocsér: a crowned yellow oval shield with a figure, within a yellow baroque frame with the year 1877, above a scroll inscribed KOCSÉR.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kocsér arms with crown, frame and scroll
